description: Ground truth read from the two phone clips by looking at frames, not from the detector. The ball is only a few pixels and was not resolved, so release is the visible bowling stride and contact is the frame the bat comes down. Times are about ±0.2 s. Runs are omitted where the ball's travel could not be seen.

scene.notes: Night practice net. Near stumps are yellow and blue. Striker in whites at the far end. Bowler in a white shirt runs in from the near end.

deliveries.notes: Bowler’s arm comes through around 20.4–20.6. The bat comes down in a block by 21.0. Ball not resolved, so runs are 0 only because the shot is a block.
Release as the front arm finishes around 40.0. Bat swings through around 40.4. Where the ball went is not visible.
Bowler in delivery stride just after 58.0. Bat follows through high around 58.8–59.0.

scene.notes: Dusk net, camera behind the bowler. Far wooden stumps are small. The bowler is mostly out of frame, so release is not labelled.

deliveries.notes: Bat swings through around 5.4. Release was not in frame.
Another swing through the line around 10.1.
Backlift then a high across follow-through at 38.8–39.2. Rough call: pull. Ball path not visible.
Bat comes down and through around 66.2.
